main_idea: GRPO training lifted Qwen3.8-27B DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO raised DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points
Trained on 500 expert-authored software engineering tasks
Tasks drawn from private, enterprise-grade codebases
Eight attempts per task, GRPO updates all parameters
